title: Water Splash & Child Audio Resonance under Deck 15 Midship Pool
impact: Cabins directly below the midship Atmosphere Pool and Polar Aquapark on Deck 14 experience running steps and splash resonance between 10:00 and 18:00.
mitigation: Choose staterooms forward of Frame 80 on Deck 12 or 13, completely insulated from active pool decks above.
evidence: Observed on MSC Meraviglia transatlantic and Caribbean deployment.

title: Pier 88/90 Escalator Bottleneck during Manhattan Embarkation
impact: Arriving outside scheduled boarding times creates 45+ minute queues along 12th Avenue curbside.
mitigation: Strictly adhere to the mobile boarding pass slot and prepare passport/ESTA documentation before ascending the 2nd-floor terminal ramp.
evidence: Audited at Manhattan Cruise Terminal Pier 88 during Sunday turnaround.
